## Types

### TargetClass

Class of a Target.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `machine` | Container or machine managed by systemd-machined.service(8). |
| `portable` | Portable service. |
| `sysext` | System extension managed by systemd-sysext.service(8). |
| `confext` | Configuration extension managed by systemd-confext.service(8). |
| `host` | Host system. |
| `component` | Component managed by systemd-sysupdate.service(8). |

### TargetIdentifier

Identifier for a component of the system (i.e. the host itself, a sysext, a confext, etc.) that can be updated by systemd-sysupdate(8).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | `TargetClass` | Where the target was enumerated. |
| `name` | `?string` | Name of the target, unique within a class. |

### Target

Type containing a configured sysupdate target.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `TargetIdentifier` | Identifier for the target. |

### Feature

Type containing a configured sysupdate feature.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Identifier for the feature. |
| `description` | `?string` | A short human readable description of the feature. |
| `documentation` | `?[]string` | URLs to documentation for the feature. |
| `appStream` | `?string` | A URL to an AppStream catalog XML file describing the feature. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | Whether the feature is enabled. |
| `suggested` | `?bool` | Whether the feature is suggested for enablement. |
| `transfers` | `?[]string` | Array of IDs of the transfers (including currently disabled ones) which are controlled by this feature. |
